>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/summary"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one campaign run's status and goal verdicts (about 1 KB): what a live view polls while the run executes. Its `revision` moves whenever any report of the run changes, so poll this and refetch the heavier reports only when it moves. Attack runs are 404: name their campaign run. Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
